scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme : For Widower
other_conditions: The applicant must be a widower (cannot be a divorcee or in a live‑in relationship).
The applicant must have a Family ID, verified through the Haryana Parivar Pehchaan Authority (HPPA).
The applicant must have been residing in Haryana for at least the last 15 years (or be a domicile of the state).
The applicant must not have more than one bank account under the PFMS; multiple accounts will be terminated and the applicant will become ineligible for future social security benefits.
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,750 payable until the beneficiary turns 60 years old.
